create_csv_sink: create a CSVSink instance to save detection data to a CSV file with bounding box coordinates and custom fields
append_detections_to_csv: append detection data with custom metadata to an open CSV sink file
parse_detection_data: parse detection objects and custom data into per-detection row dictionaries for CSV serialization
parse_field_names: parse detection and custom data fields into a sorted CSV header list with base detection columns
open_csv_sink: open a CSVSink instance to write detection data to a CSV file with automatic directory creation
